history.perspective: A7/A8, cycle 3 - Zakat, a real cross-field race found in setAsset
history.outcome: GAP FOUND AND FIXED: setAsset built its patch from the outer state.assets closure instead of prev.assets, so two different asset fields edited in the same tick could silently clobber each other. Fixed to derive from prev, matching the pattern already used for qada/tasbih/khatm. Live-reproduced the exact race via synchronous dispatchEvent calls and confirmed the fix at both DOM and storage layers.
